description: This file defines the ModelGrid class, which models the <grid> XML element within the OFBiz widget framework. It extends ModelForm and includes logic for parsing grid configurations, including handling inheritance through resource and parent resource references.

classes.name: ModelGrid
classes.description: Represents a read-only model of a grid XML element in the OFBiz widget framework, capable of handling inheritance and resource references.

methods.name: ModelGrid
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ModelGrid instance from an XML Element.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor object implementing ModelWidgetVisitor to perform operations on this model.

methods.name: getParentModel
methods.description: Resolves and creates the parent grid or form model if specified by 'extends' or 'extends-resource' attributes.
